title.value: AN ACT restricting use of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in certain consumer products.
title.provenance: AN ACT restricting use of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in certain consumer products.

pfas_definition.provenance: a class of fluorinated organic chemicals containing at least one fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: AN ACT restricting use of perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances in certain consumer products.

date.provenance: This act shall take effect July 1, 2025.

who.provenance: A manufacturer, supplier, or distributor shall not manufacture, sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use

action.provenance: A manufacturer, supplier, or distributor shall not manufacture, sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use

value: aftermarket stain and water resistant treatments for rugs or carpets
products.provenance:
A manufacturer, supplier, or distributor shall not manufacture, sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in this state a rug or carpet to which PFAS have been intentionally added in any amount.

A manufacturer, supplier, or distributor shall not manufacture, sell, offer for sale, distribute for sale, or distribute for use in this state aftermarket stain and water resistant treatments for rugs or carpets to which PFAS have been intentionally added in any amount.

value: sale or resale of used products
exceptions.provenance: This paragraph shall not apply to the sale or resale of used products.

intentionally_added.provenance: 'Intentionally added' means the addition of a chemical in a product that serves an intended function in the product component.
